correctness.rationale: Exact angular-generator harmonic closure, stationary mixed position-heading moments, and cross-covariance balance give the rational signed-area current. Every denominator factor is positive. For stiffness ratio strictly greater than 3/2 the quartic has exactly one sign variation, opposite values at zero and infinity, thus one positive root with strict current signs. At the boundary its remaining coefficients are all negative. Independent additive positional diffusion contributes no cross-variation. The standalone checker passed 237 numerical consistency assertions, not used as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The direction of an observable steady orbital transport current is reversed by changing only the orientation reset frequency while intrinsic angular drift always has the same sign. The theorem gives the unique reversal rate across a two-parameter continuous family, its sharp high-rate stiffness boundary, and invariance under translational Brownian noise.
